proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4661.2 documents candra moon, including Marathi cā̃d and Lahnda/Punjabi cann. The full Beradi candra is treated as learned vocabulary; Awan caṇ fits the contracted regional moon noun with the survey nasal articulation retained. The local Indo-Aryan transmission route remains open. Exact survey form candra is preserved.
